_comment: Read by the two borrowed release workflows and by .github/workflows/lib/.
Smalti BORROWS the release flow from repo-infra and keeps its own CI: the
standard's `repo_infra check` reports `detected nothing` for a font built
from ASCII-art text files, and teaching it a new ecosystem is a change to
that project, not to this one. So there is no `ecosystems` entry here and
nothing in this repository is generated by the standard's assembler --
validate.yml, build.yml and pages.yml are Smalti's own.
What IS borrowed, unchanged where possible: release-pr.yml,
release-publish.yml and the five files in .github/workflows/lib/. Each
carries the standard's own version marker in its first comment line; if
you update one, take the whole set.
